author: Staff Writer
title: EDITORIAL: Riley's friends support the kids - NewsBreak
text:
By Staff Writer ,
3 hours ago
If you know Mike Riley — and who doesn’t — he would probably joke that he had no idea he had a couple of hundred friends. Much less that they would show up to celebrate The Life of Riley.
But they did.
And, if you know Mike Riley, you know he probably wouldn’t have wanted the $50,000 or so raised at the weekend event to be used for anything but kids.
And it was.
The fundraiser, put together by co-chairs Debbie Munholand and Nanette Leonard and sponsored by the Peace River Rotary Club, drew plenty of people along with laughs, jokes and good food to raise money for Back Pack Kidz — a nonprofit that focuses on feeding hungry children in the state and is based in Charlotte County.
Leroy’s Southern Kitchen & Bar catered the event that featured Riley as the target of a roast by friends and former colleagues.
Riley retired from working with the Charlotte County School district in several capacities — teacher, coach and, finally, public information director.
He was also the founder of The BoogieMen band, which entertained in the area for 36 years — donating dozens of performances for charities and nonprofits.
“We’re blessed to live in this community, and we gotta keep it,” Riley said when speaking at the fundraiser. “There’s something that always sticks in my mind: forget not the children.”
They didn’t, Mike.
